messages:
maria: Heads-up: Amy's remote — she just pinged, wifi is stable but she wants slide control handed off. Also recorder threw a temp error. Can ops confirm backup?

devon (stream): Saw recorder alert: 'buffer overflow, dropping frames' at 11:03. Restarting capture service and switching to write-to-local. Will monitor encoder TTFB.

kai: I can remote-control slides. @maria give me presenter rights in the deck and I'll switch on cue.

maria: Done. Kai has control. Anna, please DM Amy the secondary dial-in and ask to mute until Q&A to avoid feedback.

anna (ops): Sending now: "Backup dial-in: https://zoom.redwood/handbook — please mute on entry. If you need to talk, use the raise-hand in Zoom and we'll unmute."

rachel: Quick note: captions were lagging ~2-3s in rehearsal. Devon, any tuning we can do?

devon (stream): Captions had 2.7s latency on the test. Increased caption-worker concurrency and switched to lower-batch size for realtime. Now reporting 1.4s. Also restarted obs with `--no-audio-threaded` to reduce audio jitter.

maria: Nice. Devon, what about the recorder permission issue?

devon (stream): Permission error when mounting NFS: "EACCES mkdir '/mnt/recorder/tmp'". Remounted with uid 1001 and gid 1001, but if it still fails fallback to ssd spool.

kai: Implemented fallback spool mount and updated nginx proxy to expose partial segments. If we need to stitch, I can handle post-process.

amy (ceo): Thanks all. If slide transitions aren't perfect, don't panic — I'll narrate through them. Also I'll keep answers to one minute for Q&A.

maria: OK final checklist: slides control to Kai, captions <1.5s, recorder on local SSD, backup dial-in sent. Anyone seeing anything else?

devon (stream): Monitoring: encoder-03 health OK, obs-capture restarted, captions latency=1.3s, recorder spool=local_ssd. Will stay on-watch for 12m.

anna (ops): Amy messaged: "Got backup link, muted. Ready to go in 2."

kai: Slides ready. I'll cue slide 1 in 15s and hand off to Amy's deck on cue. 

maria: Great. I'll post a 30s pre-start cue in the stage channel and then mark the thread closed after go-live.

amy (ceo): Launching in 10s — thanks team! :rocket: 

maria: Live. Closing thread, ops monitoring in #stream-ops for followups.
